newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Spain will support Romania in its bid to join NATO in the first wave of eastward expansion, former Romania's king Michael said after a meeting with officials at the Spanish Foreign Ministry.
* Romania's Senate approved a govrnment decree on slashing payment arrears. Under the decree, all companies and regies autonomes must pay all their debts when due.
